name: Routing System Type Check
description: Type-checks the routing system after edits to catch broken intent patterns or skill mappings

then.prompt:
A routing system file was edited. Run getDiagnostics on all routing files to check for type errors:
- doraemon/src/renderer/services/routing/types.ts
- doraemon/src/renderer/services/routing/constants.ts
- doraemon/src/renderer/services/routing/intent-detector.ts
- doraemon/src/renderer/services/routing/tool-router.ts

If there are errors, fix them immediately. The routing system must stay type-safe — broken types mean broken skill routing for Doraemon.
